description: Ask a question about a notebook's sources. Streams partial text as progress notifications. Returns the answer, citations (source, cited text, UTF-16 offsets) and the conversation id. save_as_note also saves the answer as a note (note_id, or note_error when it could not be saved). wait=false returns a job_id; poll with chat_status. Not retried after sending.

conversation_id.description: continue this conversation; default is the notebook's newest thread

new_conversation.description: start a fresh conversation instead of the default thread

notebook.description: notebook id, id prefix (6+ chars) or title

save_as_note.description: also save the answer as a note, as the web app's Save to note does (the server picks the note title)

sources.description: restrict the answer to these sources (id, id prefix or title); default all sources

wait.description: wait for the answer (default true); false returns a job_id to poll with chat_status

name: chat_ask
